Name: Fix staging deployment by rotating expired registry token in CI
Description: The staging environment is broken because the CI deploy job cannot pull the base image. The root cause is an expired registry token that was not updated when tokens were rotated yesterday. Steps: (1) Regenerate a new registry token. (2) Update the CI secret with the new registry token. (3) Re-run the staging deploy job. (4) Verify the deploy job goes green and staging is functional. (5) Confirm to Kim that staging is back online. Acceptance criteria: Staging deploy job is green, base image pulls successfully, and team members can test in staging again. Follow-up: Review token rotation process to ensure CI secrets are included in future rotations.
